title: Marrow Marketplace onramp: integration scratchpad
content:
Call notes + running checklist for Marrow Marketplace (customer: Marrow Marketplaces, B2B ecommerce).

Context / goal:
- PoC to power product search expansion and conversational storefront support.
- Customer needs a private deployment (VPC) with predictable latency for search assist and a hosted fallback.
- Primary concern: PII in product metadata and seller notes; strict retention policy.

Attendees:
- Marrow: J. Hargrove (CTO), N. Wu (Platform Eng), S. Ortega (Product), legal counsel (audio only)
- Redwood: Lena Ortiz (SE), Ravi C. (Solutions), Maya L. (infra consultant)

High-level outcomes from 2025-02-14 kickoff:
- Marrow will start with a thin integration: embeddings for product catalog + chat assistant using a 4k context model.
- They requested private control plane + on-premise connector for sensitive seller documents.
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 200ms for token generation for short completions (single-turn search queries). For chat flows allow up to 600ms.
- Cost ceiling for PoC: $3k/mo. Need to show cost-saving paths (quantization, batching) in the pilot.

Technical constraints & gotchas (notes to self):
1) Seller notes contain SSNs and addresses in free text. Must ensure two-layer redaction: a) pre-ingest regex pass + blocklist, b) runtime prompt-level redaction and audit logging. Customer insists logs be exportable and purged after 30 days.
2) They run their primary infra in us-east-1 with a private subnet and strict egress. Private deployment will need a connector VM in their network to pull model artifacts — negotiation with their infra team required.
3) Offline catalog updates: bulk embeddings jobs run nightly; these can be heavy. Need guidance on incremental embedding updates vs full re-embed cadence. Recommend incremental with upsert API and a dedupe stage.
4) Search latency spikes when sequence length > 1024 tokens (we saw a sample product description set where some OEM datasheets push length). Add truncation rules and prefer metadata-based retrieval as filter layer.
5) Model selection: they asked for the smallest model that meets quality. Run evals on 5k prompt set from their historical queries. Plan: run Hosted A/B using Redwood hosted catalog, then switch to Dedicated nodes with quantized weights for cost.
6) KMS/HSM: Marrow will provide KMS keys; need to validate supported key types and rotation schedule.
7) Observability: they want per-request token cost attribution in Console and trace IDs that map to their internal request IDs. Add a header mapping plan.

Short sample prompts (for engineering/testing):
- Retrieval prompt: "Find top 5 SKUs matching: {user_query} — prefer in-stock, prefer same-region sellers, return sku, title, short-summary(50 chars)."
- Redaction test prompt: insert sample seller notes with fake SSN '111-22-3333' and ensure pipeline strips it from both embeddings and logs.

Integration checklist (minimal PoC):
- [ ] Share sample dataset (anonymized) of 10k SKUs and 1k user queries (Marrow to deliver by 2025-02-21)
- [ ] Run initial evaluation suite (Ravi) across 5 candidate models (deadline 2025-02-28)
- [ ] Configure VPC connector proof-of-concept (Maya/Ravi) and validate no egress (target 2025-03-07)
- [ ] Implement two-stage redaction pipeline and unit tests (Lena) (target 2025-03-04)
- [ ] Cost projection + recommendation doc (quantization + batching) (Lena -> Finance) (target 2025-03-10)
- [ ] Observability header spec and placeholder Console dashboard (Maya) (target 2025-03-12)
- [ ] Security review with Marrow legal (blocklist retention & access audit) (owner: Marrow legal, coordinate: Lena) (target meeting 2025-03-05)

Open questions to drive into next call:
- Can Marrow accept best-effort detection of PII for the initial PoC or do they require a certified PII redaction product? (they leaned towards certified; legal to confirm)
- Do they want a synchronous fallback to hosted Redwood when private capacity is saturated, or prefer queued requests? Tradeoff: predictable SLA vs data residency.
- What internal ID in Marrow's requests should we use for trace mapping? They have request_id and session_id; we suggested using request_id for Console correlation.

Risks / mitigation:
- Risk: Nightly embeddings job floods ingestion pipeline. Mitigation: throttle jobs + batch upsert + backpressure docs.
- Risk: Legal demands audit export format not supported by our first pass. Mitigation: early schema check with Marrow legal.

Notes for demos / small experiments to show value quickly:
- Demo 1 (2 days): "Smart facet suggestion" — show improved search click-through using embeddings + reranking. Use a 1k subset and record CTR delta after simulated queries.
- Demo 2 (3 days): "Intent funnel" — short chat flow that maps queries to product categories + an order of magnitude faster retrieval using pre-filtering by category metadata.

Next steps (immediate):
- Send summary + checklist to Marrow (Lena) — target today 2025-02-14 EOD.
- Request anonymized sample dataset and their legal redaction requirements (Lena).
- Schedule deep-dive with infra team to unblock VPC connector (Maya) — propose times 2025-02-18/19.

Random notes / heuristics I keep forgetting:
- For retail catalogs, prefer embedding size 1536 for semantic recall; small models with 4096 context often outperform bigger models on short prompts for latency-sensitive flows.
- When customers cite "we need <200ms" make sure they mean server-side generation time, not total client-observed latency. Clarify measurement.

Slack threads / refs to attach later:
- #marrow-onramp (private channel)
- slack:thread: C03KJ9XQ (initial intro)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/marrow-proxy/pull/18 (connector prototype)

Quick logs from local test (2/20):
- Embedding job (1k rows) ran in 45s on dev-dedicated-1 (quantized) -> memory plateau at 4.2GB, CPU low. Good for cost estimate.
- Redaction unit test: regex pass removed SSN patterns in 98/100 synthetic cases; need ML-backed PII detector for edge cases.

-- Lena
(Will keep updating as we move through the checklist; aim to keep this file as the single source of truth for the SE->Marrow PoC communications)
